name: Stop invoice fraud before payment with PaperOffice AI and human approval

parameters.content:
## Stop invoice fraud before payment

**Who it is for:** accounts payable teams, controllers and ERP integrators who need a payment gate against changed bank details, duplicates and over-billing.

**What it does:** every invoice is archived and checked in [PaperOffice AI](https://paperoffice.ai/en/), then **a human decides**. This workflow never releases a payment.

### How it works
1. **Upload invoice** → **Archive invoice** stores the PDF, **Extract invoice** reads it.
2. Full-text searches in your workspace find earlier invoices of the supplier, the order, the delivery note and the same invoice number.
3. **Evaluate checks**: IBAN against earlier invoices (match / changed / unknown), duplicates, order and delivery note. Anything unclear is a finding.
4. **Add check report** writes the result to the document, **Queue for human review** creates the HITL task.
5. **Review decision** (signed webhook) tags the invoice *ready for payment* or *blocked*.

### Set up (about 10 minutes)
1. Bearer credential with your PaperOffice AI token ([Account → API](https://app.paperoffice.ai/en/paperoffice-account/api)) in all PaperOffice nodes.
2. **Settings**: workspace ID and HITL agent UUID.
3. In the HITL agent, set the webhook URL to the production URL of **Review decision**; put the signing secret into **Compute signature**.

### Customize
- Optional deep check with AI-DMS Ultra (billed per page).
- Swap the form for Gmail, Outlook or Google Drive. API reference: [llms.txt](https://api.paperoffice.ai/latest/docs/llms.txt)

## 1 · Archive and read
The PDF is stored in PaperOffice AI first, then read by document AI.

## 2 · Evidence from your DMS
Earlier invoices, order, delivery note and same invoice number are found by full-text search in your workspace.

## 3 · Report and human review
The report is stored on the document; every invoice goes to the HITL queue. Nothing is paid here.

## 4 · Decision webhook
Signed by PaperOffice AI. Only an approval tags the invoice "ready for payment".
